localNest.maxContextFiles.description: How many workspace files to include as context for a question (top matches by name/content).

localNest.model.description: Default Ollama model. Any model Ollama supports works (qwen, llama, codellama, deepseek-coder, etc.) — the chat panel lists the models actually pulled on your host and lets you switch.

localNest.ollamaHost.description: Ollama base URL. Keep localhost for fully local use, or point it at your own remote Ollama host. This extension sends code only to this host, and has no GPU/CUDA settings — Ollama manages hardware itself and runs on CPU by default.

localNest.provider.description: Model provider: Ollama (local, private), Gemini (Google API, gemini-3.8-flash), or OpenAI-compatible (LM Studio, OpenRouter, Groq, any /v1 API).

localNest.geminiModel.description: Gemini model ID. gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-2.5-flash are listed by default; any other Gemini model ID set here is also passed straight to the Gemini API.

localNest.geminiApiKey.description: Optional fallback for the Gemini API key. Prefer the secure command “Vyntra: Set Gemini API Key”, which stores it in Secret Storage instead of settings.

localNest.lowBandwidth.description: Low-bandwidth / slow network: smaller workspace context and smaller model replies.

localNest.autoFallback.description: If the selected provider is unreachable on this network, automatically try the other provider (Gemini <-> Ollama) before giving up.

localNest.temperature.description: Model temperature: 0 = precise/deterministic code, 0.2 = default for coding, 1 = creative, up to 2 = wild. Applies to Ollama, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible providers.

localNest.openaiBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. LM Studio http://localhost:1234/v1, OpenRouter https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, Groq https://api.groq.com/openai/v1.

localNest.openaiModel.description: Model ID for the OpenAI-compatible provider, as that provider names it.

localNest.openaiApiKey.description: Optional fallback for the OpenAI-compatible API key. Prefer the secure command Vyntra: Set OpenAI-compatible API Key, which stores it in Secret Storage instead of settings.

description: Local-first, plug-and-play AI coding agent for VS Code/Antigravity: multi-turn chat with history, Stop generation, retry on rate limits, temperature control, diff edits, Ask/Plan/Agent, inspect workspace first, reviewed multi-file proposals with snapshot, explicit approval, approved commands, validation after accepted edits — local Ollama, Gemini 3.8 Flash, or any OpenAI-compatible model, no separate IDE, no GPU settings.
name: vyntra
author: NitinKumar Hiremath
